# Smart File Converter - Full Technical Documentation

> Complete developer, API, and architectural overview for Smart File Converter (https://officialali.dev/).

Smart File Converter is a high-performance web application designed for fast, secure, and private document processing. All file processing occurs with instant execution and automatic cleanup.

## System Architecture

- **Frontend**: Clean semantic HTML5, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), responsive UI, and CSS grid design system.
- **Backend Framework**: Python WSGI Flask engine optimized for serverless edge deployment (Appwrite Functions / Linux Containers).
- **Core Processing Engines**:
  - `PyMuPDF (fitz)`: Ultra-fast PDF parsing, text extraction, block rendering, and image generation.
  - `python-docx`: High-fidelity Microsoft Word (.docx) file creation, XML 1.0 sanitization, and paragraph formatting.
  - `python-pptx`: Presentation slide construction and picture overlay rendering.
  - `openpyxl`: Excel spreadsheet workbook generation and grid formatting.
  - `reportlab`: Programmatic PDF generation from text, paragraphs, and data tables.
  - `Pillow (PIL)`: High-efficiency image processing, format conversion (JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP), and quality binary compression.

## Detailed Tool Specifications

### 1. Merge PDF (/merge-pdf)
Combines multiple input PDF files into a single unified PDF document. Preserves page order, bookmarks, and vector graphic quality.

### 2. Split PDF (/split-pdf)
Splits a multi-page PDF into separate single-page PDF documents. Returns individual files or a compressed ZIP archive.

### 3. Compress PDF (/compress-pdf)
Reduces PDF file size using customizable compression profiles (Low, Medium, High, or Target KB limit). Re-samples embedded raster images and compresses vector streams.

### 4. PDF to Word (/pdf-to-word)
Converts PDF files into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) documents while preserving text layout, font sizes, colors, bold/italic styles, tables, and embedded images.

### 5. PDF to PowerPoint (/pdf-to-ppt)
Converts PDF pages into 16:9 widescreen PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation slides.

### 6. PDF to Excel (/pdf-to-excel)
Parses PDF tables and grid data into structured Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) worksheets.

### 7. Word to PDF (/word-to-pdf)
Converts Microsoft Word (.docx) documents into formatted PDF files.

### 8. PPT to PDF (/ppt-to-pdf)
Converts PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation slides into PDF documents.

### 9. Excel to PDF (/excel-to-pdf)
Converts Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets into structured grid PDF tables with custom cell styling and headers.

### 10. PDF to JPG (/pdf-to-jpg)
Extracts and renders PDF pages into high-resolution 150 DPI JPG images.

### 11. JPG to PDF (/jpg-to-pdf)
Combines multiple JPG, PNG, or BMP images into a formatted multi-page PDF document.

### 12. Unlock PDF (/unlock-pdf)
Removes password protection and owner restrictions from encrypted PDF files.

### 13. Protect PDF (/protect-pdf)
Encrypts PDF files with user-specified passwords using standard PDF 128-bit encryption.

### 14. Page Numbers (/page-numbers)
Appends dynamic page numbers (e.g. "Page X of Y") to PDF footers.

### 15. Translate PDF (/translate-pdf)
Extracts text from PDF documents and translates it into selected target languages.

### 16. Compress Image (/compress-image)
Compresses JPG, PNG, and WEBP images to a specified target file size limit in KB.

### 17. Convert Image (/convert-image-format)
Converts images between JPG, PNG, WEBP, and BMP formats while standardizing color space to 32-bit RGBA or 24-bit RGB for 100% OS compatibility.

## Security & Privacy Policy

- Zero Registration: No user registration, accounts, or personal data collection required.
- File Cleanup: Input and output files are processed in ephemeral storage and cleaned up automatically.
- SSL/TLS Encryption: All data in transit is protected using HTTPS with TLS 1.3 encryption.
